Shopping with Elio

Website terms

Elio Cheesecakes by TLB Kitchen provides this website to browse our collection, place orders, manage your account and receive order updates.

Your account

Use accurate contact information and keep your sign-in details and private order links safe. Google sign-in is an optional way to access your Elio account. Creating a customer account does not grant access to the kitchen dashboard.

Ordering and payment

Product availability, prices, discounts and delivery fees are shown during checkout. Review the total, fulfillment date and contact details before placing an order. Orders require full initial payment and manual review of the payment proof. The order page shows the upload deadline and current payment and fulfillment status. Submitting an order or uploading a receipt does not mean the payment has already been approved.

Pickup, delivery and changes

Your order page provides the relevant pickup or delivery details. Delivery arrival times are not guaranteed. For changes, cancellations, refunds or payment concerns, contact the kitchen with your order reference so the team can review your request. Refund transfers are handled directly by the team.

Offers and newsletter codes

Promo codes require an eligible verified Elio account and are subject to the code’s discount, minimum, usage limits and expiry. Delivery fees are excluded from product discounts. Personal newsletter codes are tied to the subscribed email. A newsletter code may be reused after its order is refunded or cancelled, within its original expiry. Rejoining the newsletter does not issue another welcome code. See newsletter offer details and the terms included with your issued code.

Website maintenance

New orders may be paused during website maintenance. If payment-proof uploads are paused for maintenance, an eligible unpaid order keeps its remaining upload time when service resumes. Already-expired orders are not reopened.

Contact

For website or order assistance, email elio.cheesecakes@gmail.com.
